summary: StaffMessageService is a web service that provides functionality to retrieve staff messages by ID, given a session hash for authentication.
purpose: To expose a method for retrieving the message text of a staff message, identified by its ID, within the context of an authenticated session.

fields.name: sessionHash
fields.description: Hash representing the user session for authentication.

fields.name: Message
fields.description: The actual message text returned if found.

workflows.name: Get Staff Message by ID
steps: User or client sends a request to StaffMessageGetByID with sessionHash and message ID.
System resolves session ID from sessionHash.
System searches for StaffMessage using sessionID and ID.
If StaffMessage is found, return its message text.
If not found, return empty string.

business_rules: Only authenticated sessions (verified via sessionHash) can retrieve staff messages.
Message is only returned if it exists; otherwise, an empty string is returned.
validations: sessionHash must resolve to a valid session ID.
id must correspond to a valid StaffMessage for the session.
conditions: If StaffMessage for sessionID and id exists, return message text.
If StaffMessage does not exist, return empty string.
system_behavior: Provides SOAP and script service compatibility.
exceptions: Returns empty string if StaffMessage is not found.
content_gaps: No information about error handling beyond returning empty string.
Only 'get by ID' functionality is present, no create/update/delete or message list retrieval.
